Sightseeing

San Francisco Bay Highlights

The Bay has an endless supply of landmarks, wildlife, and hidden gems best seen from the water.

Golden Gate Bridge

The undisputed icon of San Francisco — pass underneath the world-famous bridge from the water for a perspective no tourist photo can capture.

Alcatraz Island

The legendary federal penitentiary on a rocky island in the middle of the bay. Circle the island by boat and take in the dramatic cliffs and ruins up close.

Angel Island

California's Ellis Island and largest bay island — featuring miles of hiking trails, 360° views of the Bay Area, and pristine anchorages for swimming and picnicking.

Sausalito

The charming waterfront town just north of the Golden Gate — colorful floating homes, upscale restaurants, and boutique shops perfect for a mid-charter stop.

Bay Bridge

The Bay Bridge connects San Francisco to Oakland and is spectacular lit up at night. The eastern span features the Bay Lights art installation — a must-see at dusk.

Marin Headlands

The dramatic, rugged cliffs north of the Golden Gate — a stunning backdrop and home to some of the best views of the bridge and San Francisco skyline.

Treasure Island

A man-made island in the middle of the bay — home to stunning panoramic views of both the SF skyline and Oakland. A hidden gem best approached by boat.

Fisherman's Wharf

The historic commercial fishing harbor with iconic cable cars, fresh seafood, and the famous sea lion colony at Pier 39.

Tiburon & Belvedere

Some of the most desirable real estate in the Bay Area with charming waterfront restaurants and a spectacular view of the SF skyline across the water.
